title: HS30035: Technology Transfer And Economic Development
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: NoneCourse ContentsIntroduction: Interrelationship between
Industrialization, Transfer of Technology and Economic Development; Some Basic
Concepts and Analytical Tools of Development Economics; Characteristics of
Underdevelopment; Problems and Pattern of Industrialization in Developing
Economy; Socio-Economic Dualism; Structural and Organizational Change in the
Process of Economic Development; Industrialization and Urbanization; Growth of
Entrepreneurship; Industrial Policy and Planning in India with Particular
Emphasis on Foreign Capital and Technology Transfer; Optimum Resource Use in
the Context of Changing Technology; Levels of Technology; Technology Gap;
Intra-National and International Transfer of Technology; Need for Adaptation
and Development of Appropriate Technology; Multinational Corporations and
Transfer of Technology; Situation in India: Import of Technology to India;
Country-Wise Experience; Transfer of Technology between the Developing
Countries, Development of Human Resources and Technology Transfer, Import
Substitution and Development of Indigenous Technology.
